# Ushka

> Ushka is an async (ASGI) Python web framework with filesystem routing, built so that insecure code does not run silently. Its main feature, Ushka Guard, makes everything that comes from outside the program (query, form, JSON, headers, cookies, path parameters, and LLM output marked with `guard.llm()`) an `Untrusted` string, and the dangerous sinks (raw HTML responses, the `|safe` filter, `redirect()`, file paths, raw SQL) refuse it with an error that states the risk and the fix. It has a security middleware on by default (CSRF, CSP, HSTS, CORS, trusted hosts), typed parameters and validation without pydantic, `Depends`, WebSockets, SSE, OpenAPI, routes as MCP tools, an async ORM, and `ushka verify`, which attacks your own routes. The core needs only uvicorn, uvloop, httptools, jinja2 and python-multipart. Python 3.10+; t-strings on 3.14.

Rules for generating Ushka code:

- Routes: `routes/index.py` is `/`; `routes/users/[user_id].py` is `/users/<user_id>`. Export functions named after the verb: `async def get(request): ...` (also `post`, `put`, `patch`, `delete`, `websocket`). Or use decorators on `app = Ushka()`: `@app.get("/path")`.
- Run it with `ushka dev` (reload, debug on) or `ushka run` (production). The app object is `app` in `app.py`; serve it as `app:app`.
- Return a `str`, `dict`/`list` (JSON), `(body, status)` or `(body, status, headers)`, `None` (204), a t-string (3.14, escaped HTML) or `Response`. Raise `HttpNotFound`, `HTTPForbidden`, `HTTPBadRequest` (from `ushka.http.exceptions`) with `message=` as a keyword.
- Type the parameters: `async def get(item_id: int, page: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1)] = 1)`. Bodies are dataclasses or TypedDicts, and `Depends(fn)` injects dependencies. Invalid input answers 422 with every error; for an HTML form use `Annotated[MyDataclass, Form()]` and `@app.post(path, on_invalid=fn)` to draw the form again with `errors.fields` and `errors.values`. An `int`, `UUID`, `Enum` or `Literal` parameter is validated and plain; a `str` stays `Untrusted`. Imports: `from ushka import Query, Header, Cookie, Path, Body, Form, Field, Depends`.
- Never put request values straight into `redirect()`, HTML strings, `|safe`, file paths or raw SQL. Use `from ushka import safe`: `safe.url(v, allow=["/"], default="/")`, `safe.path(v, root)`, `safe.integer(v, min=, max=)`, `safe.choice(v, options)`, `safe.html(v)`. A rejected value answers 400.
- Render HTML with `await render(request, "page.html", {...})` (`from ushka import render`); Jinja2 autoescapes. On 3.14 return `t"<h1>{name}</h1>"`.
- SQL: ORM methods (`await User.filter(name=name)`), `db.text("... :id", id=value)`, or `await db.execute(t"... {value}")`. Not `sqlalchemy.text()` and not f-strings.
- Mark model output with `guard.llm(text)` (`from ushka import guard`) so it is `Untrusted` too.
- Config: `ushka.toml` (no secrets) < `.env` < env vars `USHKA_<SECTION>_<KEY>` (lists as `a,b`). Secret: `USHKA_APP_SECRET_KEY`. Production: `debug = false`, set `[security] allowed_hosts`, run `ushka check --production`.
- Browser writes (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`) from another site get 403 (CSRF, no tokens). Allow origins with `[security] csrf_trusted_origins`.
- WebSocket: `async def websocket(ws)` in `routes/`, or `@app.websocket("/ws")`. SSE: return `EventSourceResponse(async_generator)`.
- Expose a route to agents with `@tool(reads=[...], writes=[...])` from `ushka.mcp` and `app.enable_mcp()`; sensitive tools need an approver and a token (`USHKA_MCP_TOKEN`).
- Run `ushka verify app:app` to attack your own routes and see what got through.
- If you hit `UnsafeValueError USHKA-G00x`, apply the `fix` it gives. Do not disable the guard (`[security] taint = false`) and do not use `safe.trust()` without a reason.

## Start

- [Installation](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/install/): pip, extras (orm, postgres, mysql, docs, full), the install script
- [Quickstart](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/quickstart/): a running app in five minutes
- [Project structure](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/project-structure/): what `ushka new` creates
- [Why Ushka changed](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/why-ushka-changed/): purpose and direction
- [Features](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/features/): the short tour

## Guide

- [Routing](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/routing/): file and decorator routes, dynamic segments, hooks
- [Requests and responses](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/requests-responses/): the request object, return values, Response, redirect
- [Validation and typed parameters](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/validation/): types, Query/Header/Body, Depends, 422 errors, OpenAPI
- [Testing](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/testing/): `ushka.testing.TestClient` runs startup/shutdown, keeps cookies, sends json/forms/files, simulates a browser for CSRF
- [Dependency Injection](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/dependency_injection/): request, response and config in a handler
- [Templates](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/templates/): Jinja2, filters, globals, context processors
- [Static files](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/static_files/): the static folder, caching, `app.mount_static`
- [Sessions, cookies and uploads](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/sessions/): signed sessions, cookies, multipart files
- [SEO](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/seo/): `{{ seo() }}` tags, robots.txt and sitemap.xml ready from `[seo]` in ushka.toml, per-page overrides
- [Progressive Web App](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/pwa/): `[pwa]` in ushka.toml serves the manifest, a conservative service worker and an offline page
- [Flash messages](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/flashing/): one-time messages between requests
- [Error handling](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/error_handling/): HTTP errors, custom pages, debug mode
- [ORM](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/orm/): models, queries, raw SQL, migrations
- [WebSockets and SSE](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/realtime/): sockets, events, streaming
- [Routes as agent tools](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/agents/): MCP, capabilities, human approval
- [Ushka Docs](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/docs/): documentation sites from Markdown, with a cache

## Security

- [Ushka Guard](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/guard/): sources, sinks, sanitisers, error codes USHKA-G001 to G005, limits
- [Security middleware](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/security/): CSRF, headers, CORS, trusted hosts, your own middleware
- [ushka verify](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/verify/): attack your own routes
- [Guard on FastAPI, Starlette, Django](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/guard-frameworks/): the same protection in other frameworks

## Run it

- [Configuration](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/configuration/): all 76 settings with defaults and meaning (nothing hidden), `ushka config` to inspect them, `ushka new` writes them all, .env and environment variables

- [CLI](https://ushka.satela.com.br/docs/guide/cli/): new, dev, run, check, verify, docs, routes, db
